title: At the Market
introduction: Read a simple shopping conversation and notice how to ask about prices.
paragraphs: Mia is at the market. She wants some apples and oranges. She asks the seller, 'How much are the apples?' The seller says, 'They are three euros a kilo.'
Mia buys one kilo of apples and two oranges. She also wants a bottle of water. She says, 'Can I have a bottle of water, please?' The seller smiles and gives her the things.
